dota-charity-desc: TeaGuvnor is live, raising money to support cancer care. Watch, share, and help the cause.
tormentor-data-desc: The data for Tormentor kills has been removed because it turned out that in 2025, Valve awarded players points not for the last hit, but for participating in the Tormentor kill in general. My apologies for the mistake.

select-your-stats-desc: Choose your stats and their multipliers
select-your-stats-instruction: * Enter fraction instead of percents, for example if you have 270% multiplier enter 2.7 instead.
watchers-taken-desc: Watchers Taken data is slightly higher. In the 2025 Fantasy Dota 2 stats, Valve counted only NEUTRAL watchers taken. I found data that includes both NEUTRAL and ENEMY watchers taken, so this calculator counts both. As a result, the “Watchers Taken” statistic here is not completely accurate and is slightly higher than the actual value.
no-data-desc: There is no data for this stat yet
